memory_update.text: AMKR is the cleanest US-listed direct OSAT mapping for AI advanced-packaging capacity, but its market cap is already large; keep as reference anchor rather than primary underfollowed alpha candidate.
ACMR is a second-order FOPLP/panel-level packaging equipment candidate; survival in later layers depends on confirming production-scale advanced-packaging orders and customer identities.
COHU is a backend HBM inspection/metrology and test-gate candidate; current HBM revenue appears small, so the key check is whether HBM orders scale materially beyond early guidance.

ONTO is a larger but relatively pure advanced-packaging process-control candidate with disclosed AI packaging orders and HBM/2.5D qualifications; monitor whether market attention has already priced the exposure.

US-listed direct OSAT universe is narrow. Non-US OSATs such as Powertech, ASE, KYEC, and other Taiwan/Korea/Malaysia backend names may be more direct for the overflow thesis but require a separate non-US listing pass.
For this node, the investable US-listed map splits into direct OSAT capacity, FOPLP/panel-level process tools, HBM inspection/metrology, and advanced-packaging lithography/process-control gates.

node: Advanced packaging, fan-out panel-level packaging, memory backend, and OSAT overflow
summary: Layer 1B universe expansion for the AI advanced-packaging/OSAT-overflow node. The underfollowed lane favors US-listed companies tied to outsourced packaging capacity, panel-level/fan-out tooling, HBM inspection/test gates, and backend yield bottlenecks rather than mega-cap AI accelerator leaders. Direct OSAT exposure is limited among US-listed equities, so the list mixes one direct OSAT reference with three second-order public assets whose products can become gating tools as HBM, chiplet, fan-out, and panel-level packaging capacity expands. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
